payload.entry: QUALIFY CONTRACT for ci-evidence/release-wiring: `.github/release-qualification.json` schema_version=1 separates the Master Gate admission policy from release checks. Blocking qualification jobs are lint (command evidence) and test (3.12/3.13/3.14) (pytest evidence); the exercise entry names the existing four Linux/macOS wheel/sdist legs for `exercise_release`; visual-test, perf-floors, tutorial-tests, and ace-page-group-isolation are advisory. Each blocking CI entry requires completed `Write qualification evidence` and `Upload qualification evidence` job steps. `release_candidate qualify --manifest M --inventory I --jobs J --evidence-dir D --run-id R --attempt A --out O` reads normalized job-history schema_version=1: candidate identity, inventory_digest, workflow_run_id/current_attempt, and contiguous attempt snapshots with workflow_file, workflow_job_id, matrix, numeric job_id, exact job_name, workflow_run_id, execution_attempt, status, conclusion, URL, timestamps, step outcomes, and relative evidence_file. Each evidence binding carries repository, candidate_id, generation, checked_out_sha, expected_core_version, installed_core_version, inventory_digest, workflow_run_id, job_id, job_name, and attempt. Pytest evidence carries collected/passed/failed/errors/skipped, collection_failed, exit_status, first_failing_node_ids, and verbatim flaky_lines; command evidence carries completed step outcomes and missing_bindings/diagnostics, never pytest counts. `qualify` appends exact inventory bytes and loaded payloads before returning exit 2 on red; `evaluate` revalidates them and rejects bare pass, stale identity, and ambiguous history. Rerun eligibility is first-attempt test failures only; attempt 2 requires an all-test red first attempt, new evidence for rerun jobs, and unchanged proof for carried successes.

Added versioned N1 qualification inventory and candidate-bound evaluator/CLI; focused release-candidate tests passed (62 tests); sase tool run check passed including scoped tests (13m 51s); epic-symbols clear.
